extracted.stage: Pre-application; IHT computation not yet finalised
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an estate worth about £572,500 is asking for lending criteria and indicative pricing ahead of a possible borrowing against the property to pay inheritance tax and fees.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the administration of this estate. So that we can consider it properly, we would need the amount the executors expect to borrow once the IHT computation is available, confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, and details of the estate assets including the property to be charged. It would also help to have confirmation of the grant position and any relevant deadlines. We will come back to you with our criteria and the further information we require once we have reviewed what you send.
